definitions.ask: Should . and ; also alias ^ and : at the other picker spots (whole-item ., project-note bullets)?
definitions.why: Matches the request; .-led text such as .bashrc is common enough to surprise you

choices.label: Only @route. / @route; / whole-item ; alias; text like .bashrc or - .env stays literal
Whole-item . and bullet - . / - ; / trailing . ; also open pickers; .-led text needs Undo

definitions.ask: Should a second . or ; right after its alias turn it back into the literal key, like \\ does?
definitions.why: Undo already restores the literal key; a double tap adds a key path through every picker

choices.label: Command-Z restores the literal key, as for every other rewrite gesture; no new key state
A second same key on an empty picker filter puts the literal back; adds Mac arm state
